notes: Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B), heavy user-facing search + contextual help
Initial trial: onboarded to Hosted API (Jan 2026) — 2-week pilot with production-like traffic via canary. Saw ~120k tokens/day at baseline, spikes up to 450k tokens/day during customer events.
Primary asks: lower per-token cost and predictable latency for customer-facing chat; routing/fallback between high-capacity cheaper models and low-latency variants for premium customers.
Quote from VP Eng: 'Need a committed pool we can count on during our weekly flash reports — bursty QPS is the killer.'
Security: must support SSO (SAML), KMS integration for key rotation, audit logs stored for 365 days, data residency in NA for PII-derived features.
Cost sensitivity: Finance model shows Hosted API costs ~3x what they'd pay with a Reserved/Dedicated arrangement at sustained QPS — target ~40% reduction in unit cost to greenlight contract.

Technical notes: token mix observed during trial — ~60% short chat turns (30–80 tokens), ~30% medium generation (200–800 tokens), ~10% long-run document summarization (1k–2.5k tokens). Average response latency target: p95 < 350ms for short-chat paths.

Traffic pattern: baseline 6–8 QPS, predictable daily peaks 18–25 QPS, occasional event spikes to 60 QPS for 10–30 minutes. Concurrency observed on trial: sustained concurrency ~45 for chat endpoints when peak traffic hits.

POC notes: SE ran a replayed traffic POC against a single dedicated pool (g4-equivalent) — saw 2.8x throughput improvement versus hosted trial under same load; cache hit-rate for prefix caching ~22% which muted token usage by ~12%.

Requested deliverables: 1) Dedicated capacity sizing (QPS -> GPU count, reserve vs burst plan). 2) Traffic forecast model with day/week seasonality (spreadsheet in Drive). 3) Dedicated pricing quote with tiers for burst credit and overage rules. 4) Security artifact pack (SOC2 + data residency confirmation).
Sales/contract: procurement timeline: internal budget sync mid-March; procurement committed if price delta and SLA acceptable. Forecasted close: Apr 2026.

Next tactical: schedule 90-minute capacity workshop (include infra, finance, legal). AE to send updated pricing and capacity spreadsheet after workshop. SE to prepare test harness for dedicated POC (2 weeks).
Open concerns: legal wants clearer uptime SLA and penalty matrix; infra needs how VPC peering affects egress billing; product wants fallback policy for model downgrade during overloads.
